tokens.name: bg-default
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything: the content area of every screen.

tokens.name: bg-surface-100
tokens.usage: Sidebar, cards, table body, image cards. One step above the page.

tokens.name: bg-surface-200
tokens.usage: Inputs, table header, code blocks, read-only fields, hover on a surface-100 row.

tokens.name: bg-surface-300
tokens.usage: Pressed and selected rows, the dragged row of a sortable list. Muted text is not used here.

tokens.name: bg-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus, popovers and toasts; always together with shadow-overlay.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative only: never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of cards, tables, dialogs and the sidebar edge.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, checkboxes and default buttons: 3:1 on bg-default, bg-surface-100/200 and bg-overlay in both themes.

tokens.name: fg-default
tokens.usage: Body text, table cells, labels and headings on every bg-* token.

tokens.name: fg-light
tokens.usage: Secondary text: column headers, helper text, metadata, inactive nav items. 4.5:1 on every bg-* token.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Placeholders, captions, empty states, read-only values. 4.5:1 on every bg-* token.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one accent as ink: links, the active nav marker, focus ring, selected check, brand icons. Text on every bg-* token.

tokens.name: brand-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button and the single most important action on a screen. Not for text.

tokens.name: brand-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover.

tokens.name: on-brand-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-fill and brand-fill-hover (7:1).

tokens.name: brand-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, brand badge, the highlight of a pending upload; brand text sits on it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, the danger badge, field errors, destructive icons. Text on every bg-* token and on danger-subtle.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of an error alert or danger badge.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of a destructive confirm button (Delete in a dialog).

tokens.name: on-danger-fill
tokens.usage: Text on danger-fill (5.8:1 dark, 6.4:1 light).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and badge ink: blocked accounts, public buckets, unsaved state.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of a warning alert or badge.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and badge ink: invited, pending, hints.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of an info alert or badge.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline with 2px offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a dialog.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Page title in the app bar area: the resource or page name.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog titles, card titles, the record title above a form.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a form: Product images, Change history.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: inputs, table cells, buttons, menu items.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense tables, helper text under fields, nav items.
styles.sample: Images can be added after the first save.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Object paths, schema.table names, IDs, SQL, role names.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Paths and IDs under thumbnails and in captions.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text in a button, badge padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, between label and input, cell padding block.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and cell padding inline, gap in a toolbar.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and dialog padding, gap between form fields, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between form sections and between cards in a gallery.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding on desktop, gap above a section heading.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, kbd and code chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, image thumbnails, nav items, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, dialogs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and the language switch only.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus, toasts. Nothing that sits in the page flow gets a shadow.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Icon buttons in cards and table rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs: the default control height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Sign-in form controls only.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Width of the navigation sidebar on desktop.

tokens.name: thumb-md
tokens.usage: Image preview in a gallery card and in the image field.
